title: Social Security Survivor Benefits: Who Qualifies and How Much
bigPicture: This is money the government gives to help you when your husband or wife passes away.
whatYouNeedToKnow: You can get this money if you are a widow or widower age 60 or older.
You might be able to get it earlier if you have a disability.
The amount you get depends on how much your late spouse earned while working.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Waiting too long to apply. You should apply as soon as you can.
Thinking you lose all benefits if you remarry. You might still get benefits depending on your age.
actionSteps: Call the Social Security office or visit their website to start your claim.
Gather your marriage certificate and your spouse's death certificate.
Check your spouse's work earnings record to make sure it is correct.
